dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: Can you not see that I'm looking for something?

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: By the way... I wonder if you've seen a girl I know?

dialogues.speaker: Yue Chuan
dialogues.text: She sometimes comes here for a stroll, always dressed beautifully — you can tell just by looking that she's from a well-to-do family.
